## Script to calculate the PVL from qPCR results

```{r}
## Loading packages
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, tidyplots, readxl)
#--------------------
## Reading excel file
file_list <- list.files(
  path = "/Users/denriquez/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-KagoshimaUniversity/Project_HTLV1 Peru_2025/2507_HTLVpaper/PVL",
  pattern = "\\.xls$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
#--------------------
# Read and combine all files first
all_SS <- purrr::map_dfr(file_list, function(file) {
  read_xls(file, skip = 6) |>
    dplyr::filter(Task == "UNKNOWN") |>
    dplyr::select(
      ID = `Sample Name`,
      target = `Target Name`,
      Qmean = `Quantity Mean`,
      Qsd = `Quantity SD`
    )
})

head(all_SS)
#--------------------
## PVL calculation
all_pvl <- all_SS |>
  group_by(ID, target) |>
  summarise(
    Qmean = mean(Qmean, na.rm = TRUE),
    Qsd = mean(Qsd, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = target,
    values_from = c(Qmean, Qsd)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    PVL2 = Qmean_P30 *2  / (Qmean_Globin*8) * 100,
    CV_P30 = (Qsd_P30 / Qmean_P30) * 100,
    CV_Globin = (Qsd_Globin / Qmean_Globin) * 100,
    SD_PVL2 = PVL2 * sqrt((Qsd_P30 / Qmean_P30)^2 + (Qsd_Globin / Qmean_Globin)^2)
  )

pvl_summary_stats <- all_pvl %>%
  filter(!is.na(PVL2)) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_pvl = median(PVL2, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_pvl = sd(PVL2, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pvl = mean(PVL2, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_pvl = IQR(PVL2, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_pvl = quantile(PVL2, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_pvl = quantile(PVL2, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(pvl_summary_stats)

## Median and mean using Hmisc
pvl_ci_hmisc <- all_pvl %>%
  filter(!is.na(PVL2)) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_pvl = mean(PVL2, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_pvl = median(PVL2, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Bootstrap confidence interval
    ci_results = list(Hmisc::smean.cl.boot(PVL2, conf.int = 0.95))
  ) %>%
  unnest_wider(ci_results) %>%
  rename(
    ci_lower = Lower,
    ci_upper = Upper
  )

print(pvl_ci_hmisc)

#--------------------
## Select only PVL
all_pvl <- all_pvl |>
dplyr::select(ID, PVL2, SD_PVL2)

DT::datatable(all_pvl)

#--------------------
## Read the original database and update
HTLV_db =googlesheets4::read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/14eZCI8lRsfIebXu-tpAxbuPEOhE6moAnTDKKKUQyNOI/edit?gid=1608446469#gid=1608446469", sheet="Sheet3")
```
